name: deepresearch-bench-reference-clean
description: A cleaned reference dataset intended to benchmark models on research-oriented text tasks (e.g., answering or summarizing scientific/research content). It measures the ability to produce accurate, reference-aligned outputs given research-focused prompts and cleaned reference answers. The collection is targeted at evaluating fidelity to reference material and concise content generation.
reputation: Community-contributed dataset on Hugging Face with limited, niche adoption for research-text evaluation.
